request.style: English, male solo voice, ancient harp, soft flute, gentle piano, warm strings, deep cello, contemplative and soothing, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Turn away from evil and do good
Seek peace and pursue it day by day
The eyes of the LORD are on the righteous
His ears are open to their cry

[Chorus]
The LORD is near to the brokenhearted
He saves those crushed in spirit
They cried out and the LORD heard
He delivered them from all their troubles

[Verse]
The face of the LORD is set against evil
To cut off their memory from the earth
Many are the afflictions of the righteous
But the LORD delivers him from them all

[Chorus]
The LORD is near to the brokenhearted
He saves those crushed in spirit
They cried out and the LORD heard
He delivered them from all their troubles

[Bridge]
He watches over all his bones
Not one of them is broken
Evil will put the wicked to death
And the guilty will bear their guilt

[Chorus]
The LORD is near to the brokenhearted
He saves those crushed in spirit
They cried out and the LORD heard
He delivered them from all their troubles

[Outro]
Near to the brokenhearted
Crushed in spirit he saves
